SELECT ss.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, ss.ITEM_NAME as project, ss.ITEM_NAME as subjectName, ss.ITEM_CODE as sortNum, sum(ss.ITEM1_AMT) as tIncomeFund, /*实收基金*/ sum(ss.ITEM2_AMT) as tUnQuarterProfit, /*未分配利润*/ sum(ss.ITEM3_AMT) as tOwnerEquityTot, /*所有者权益合计*/ sum(ss.ITEM4_AMT) as tOtherCompIncome /*其他综合收益*/ FROM VAL_TABLE_SCOE ss WHERE 1=1 and ss.bookset_id = #{booksetIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ss.cdate = to_date(#{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND ss.cdate > to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND ss.cdate <= to_date(#{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
GROUP BY ss.BOOKSET_ID,ss.ITEM_NAME ,ss.ITEM_CODE ORDER BY ss.BOOKSET_ID,ss.ITEM_CODE
SELECT TO_CHAR(B.BOOKSET_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') valDate FROM bok_bookset_date B WHERE B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(B.BOOKSET_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') valDate FROM SYS_BATCH_GRP_PRDLINK A LEFT JOIN bok_bookset_date B ON A.PRODUCT_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID WHERE A.GROUP_SEQ = #{booksetGroup}

SELECT ss.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, ss.ITEM_NAME as project, ss.ITEM_NAME as subjectName, ss.CDATE as valDate, ss.ITEM1_AMT as tIncomeFund, /*实收基金*/ ss.ITEM2_AMT as tUnQuarterProfit, /*未分配利润*/ ss.ITEM3_AMT as tOwnerEquityTot, /*所有者权益合计*/ ss.ITEM4_AMT as tOtherCompIncome /*其他综合收益*/ FROM VAL_TABLE_SCOE ss WHERE 1=1 AND ss.ITEM_CODE = '1' and ss.bookset_id = #{booksetIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ss.cdate = to_date(#{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND ss.cdate > to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND ss.cdate <= to_date(#{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
ORDER BY ss.BOOKSET_ID,ss.CDATE ASC

SELECT ss.ITEM_NAME as project, ss.ITEM_NAME as subjectName, ss.CDATE as valDate, ss.ITEM1_AMT as tIncomeFund, /*实收基金*/ ss.ITEM2_AMT as tUnQuarterProfit, /*未分配利润*/ ss.ITEM3_AMT as tOwnerEquityTot /*所有者权益合计*/ FROM VAL_TABLE_SCOE ss WHERE 1=1 AND ss.ITEM_CODE = '7' AND ss.bookset_id = #{booksetId}
AND ss.cdate = to_date(#{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND ss.cdate > to_date(#{vdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND ss.cdate <= to_date(#{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
ORDER BY ss.CDATE DESC
